# Producer Fixture Source

`index.fixture.json`, `detail.fixture.json`, `detail-full-only.fixture.json`, and
`detail-game-only.fixture.json` are byte-for-byte copies of
`contracts/public-lyrics/v2/` from the producer worktree used for the shared
Public Lyrics v2 contract. Do not hand-edit their schema or wrap them in a
consumer-specific fixture shape.
